title: Tree (trees/items/<id>/tree.json)
description: A tree or a shrub as the house view draws it: a simple shape and up to four renderings, one per season.

latin.description: Botanical name, to tell two species apart (Quercus robur). Unique in the catalog.

shape.description: round: a crown of leafy blobs (oak, birch, cherry, a shrub); conical: stacked cones (pine, fir, yew).

evergreen.description: Keeps its foliage in winter (snow settles on it). A deciduous tree should give its four seasons.

height.description: Height of the top of the tree, in metres: the usual one in a garden, and the bounds offered when it is placed.

crown_radius.description: Widest radius of the crown, in metres, for a tree of the default height.

trunk.description: The trunk, for a tree of the default height.

height.description: Height of the bare trunk, in metres: the crown starts there (0: branches from the ground).

radius.description: Radius of the trunk at the ground, in metres.

seasons.description: One rendering per season. Summer is mandatory; a missing season is drawn like summer.
